title: Spiriti! Napoli '97
subtitle: Unofficial Ghostbusters-inspired tribute game set in Naples, 1997
acknowledgements: A tribute to the paranormal-comedy arcade tradition popularized by Ghostbusters and 1980s home-computer games
content_notice: TRIBUTE GAME — unofficial and unaffiliated. Ghostbusters is referenced only to identify the work being paid tribute to. The game uses original branding, artwork, music, SFX, and code designed to evoke the era without reproducing protected franchise assets.

controls.action: Choose district / steer Fiat 500 / move trap

start_prompt: Press A to start the night shift
tribute_statement: Spiriti! Napoli '97 is an unofficial, non-commercial tribute game celebrating the paranormal-comedy arcade tradition associated with Ghostbusters and the 1984 era. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by the Ghostbusters rights holders. All cartridge code, pixel artwork, title treatment, arrangements, melodies, sound effects, and recordings in this project are original; no Ghostbusters logo, character art, dialogue, soundtrack melody, recording, or game asset is included.
